agentVoice.reservesTheKeyFor: Reserves the key for Diddy system-wide (desktop shortcut portal on Wayland, global shortcut on X11 and Windows). Other apps, such as a dictation tool using the same key, then no longer get it; use a key of its own, or leave this off and let the tool run diddy --agent-voice.

agentVoice.alsoWhileDiddyIs: Also while Diddy is in the background (macOS reads the key from the system).
agentVoice.fnGlobeCanOnly: Fn / Globe can only be read by the Diddy app on macOS.

general.removesBackgroundNoiseSuch: Removes background noise such as keyboard, fan and room noise from your microphone (RNNoise, open source). It runs inside Diddy and does not turn your music down. Applies the next time you join a call.
general.echoCancellationNoiseSuppression: Echo cancellation, noise suppression and auto gain. Off keeps your music and other apps sounding normal and avoids short audio glitches when you join a call. Turn it on if you use speakers instead of headphones. Applies the next time you join a call.
general.usedForVideoIn: Used for video in calls. Changing it switches the camera of a running call too.
general.diddyRemembersTheVolume: Diddy remembers the volume and mute for me you give each person (and their screen share) on this device. Reset puts everyone back to 100 % from their next call on.

watchTogether.videosLoadFromYoutube: Videos load from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) in YouTube's own player, so YouTube sees your IP address and what you watch; ads YouTube shows are not blocked. The others in the call get the video link and play / pause / position as end-to-end encrypted messages (plain to-device messages when encryption is unavailable). For SponsorBlock only the first 4 characters of a hash of the video id go to sponsor.ajay.app, not the video itself.
watchTogether.watchAYoutubeVideo: Watch a YouTube video with everyone in the call. Play, pause and seeking are shared; your volume and quality stay yours.
watchTogether.communityDataFromSponsorblock: Community data from SponsorBlock (sponsor.ajay.app, by Ajay Ramachandran and contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). When you skip, the video jumps for everybody in the call.
